notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
